title: Exxon Mobil Corporation Form 10-K (synthetic)
text: Guyana net production averaged 640 kbd, up from 420 kbd, with Yellowtail and Uaru still ramping. The Pioneer integration added Permian operated capacity and is described as complete for organization and midstream interconnect; synergy run-rate is $2.1 billion versus a $2.0 billion target. Upstream volumes grew 11%. Refining cracks compressed: downstream earnings fell 34% even as upstream volume stacked higher, so the earnings mix shifted toward the advantaged-barrel Guyana and Permian stack and away from the crack-sensitive refining book.
